acceptance.item: P6-MERGE-TV-01: T13's narrower tables no longer reflow at 320 px in ToolFrame's table view (the inner fieldset keeps min-inline-size: min-content)
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/table-reflow.spec.ts > at 320 the table "The three conditions" of satake b10 on /modules/m9-real-forms/ is laid out within the width of its table view (with the contrast case: at 320 the table "Verdict" of lab on /tools/lab/ is laid out within the width of its table view)
acceptance.evidence: Severity minor. Red on base 36781de: 1 failed, 6 passed, 'laid out 315.78125 pixels wide in a box 288 wide (its narrowest layout is 231.125, the widest table of the view needs 315.78125)'. This matches the confirmer's 316 px. The T4 contrast case passed. The same red came from the branch's test on a scratch-revert build. Cause: the fieldset .table-fields that RT-FIX P6-RT-05-02 placed inside the scroll box div.bare kept the UA default min-inline-size: min-content. So it was as wide as the widest table, and every narrower table was laid out at that width. The old fieldset.bare had min-width: 0. Fix: min-width: 0 on .table-fields. Green: table-reflow + frozen-table-scroll 12 passed. A probe of all 331 tables in the table views of 41 routes at 320 found that only T13's 14 narrower tables changed, all back to 288 px. No other table changed. Every box's scrollWidth is unchanged, so a wider table still scrolls in its named tab-stop box. nojs 198 passed, a11y 91 passed, axe at 320 with the table views open on M9, /tools/satake/ and /embed/satake/ clean. Size 90 routes, 0 over budget, and no JavaScript changed apart from the embedded build commit. Engine 2728 passed (baseline 2728). Commit 8569f31.

openQuestions: site/tests/e2e/M9.spec.ts:381 ('the panel figures without JavaScript', regression P6-RT-06-01, written by shared-a11y on 9b24eea) asserts data-board="restricted" on the b7/b12 restricted board's node buttons. ba3dba8 (RT-FIX P6-RT-10-05, t13 cluster, an ancestor of 36781de) changed RestrictedBoardView.svelte to data-board="populations". So the test fails on the integration head 36781de with or without this change: 'b7 Expected: "restricted" Received: "populations"'. The two merged clusters disagree, and this belongs to t13-followup or MERGE. I did not touch it, because T13's files and that test are outside this item.
handoff: Both changed files are in the shared-a11y area that this item names: one CSS declaration in ToolFrame.svelte's .table-fields rule and two new tests at the end of table-reflow.spec.ts. The LaTeX branch's edit near the Export LaTeX prop is not in this hunk. A lens rerun can rely on this: T13's narrower tables now lay out at 288 px at 320, the box keeps tabindex 0 and role group, and it still scrolls to 370 px where the restricted table needs it. The one failing browser test seen, M9.spec.ts:381, was already failing at the base (openQuestions). The prompt's suggested fix (min-inline-size: 0 on the inner fieldset) was followed, written as min-width: 0 to match the file's other fieldsets.
